name: Mirrorgazer
description: A black horse of the Nether with ram's horns that are black at the root and burn into a colour of their own at the points - and wherever it walks it leaves glowing hoofprints in that same colour. Its eyes are the worst of it: black where the whites should be, and a red iris that glows. Every one of them watches you after dark in its own way, and half are shadowcreatures besides.
notes: Owner's spec, 2026-10-01: normal sized, all black, glowing red irises and black scleras, half shadowcreatures, every night-watch variation, ram horns black at the base with any colour at the tip, molten hoofprints the colour of the horn tip, Nether only.
ALL BLACK: E/E a/a on every founder, no dilution, no white.
EYES: Red/Red at both iris loci, Blk/Blk at both sclera loci, Glo/Glo at both iris-glow loci and neither sclera-glow locus - so the iris glows and the black sclera does not.

NIGHT: Shc/Shc in half and nothing in the other half (shadowcreature is recessive, so no silent carriers). Every night-watch variation - the five matched pairs, the only pairs that express - at a fifth each, so every Mirrorgazer watches you after dark in one of the five ways.

HORNS: Rh/Rh on every founder, so mares are horned too. All four shapes at a quarter each, each as a matched pair so the breed shows all four and breeds each true. Shade is pinned to 1.0, which is black, so the base is always black; Tip/Tip colours the points, and the tip colour is left wild - any colour, inherited and drifting with the line.
PRINTS: MltH/MltH, the molten hooves allele that prints in the colour of the horn tips, so a Mirrorgazer's hoofprints always match its horns, horse by horse.

Fireproof (Frp/Frp) was NOT in the owner's spec: added because a horse that spawns only in the Nether otherwise burns in its own biome, as both other Nether breeds are fireproof for. Remove the row if that was not wanted.
Spawns like the other Nether breeds: the same spawn_ground floor list and spawn_in_dark, since vanilla's animal rule wants grass and light the Nether does not have.

Heat tolerance is Htol/Htol on every founder, fixed the way the Rimehart's cold tolerance is: every breed that spawns in the Nether is heat tolerant, as a rule (BreedClimate, owner's rule 2026-10-01).
